text:
ops-bot: ALERT: 3rd-party synth probe 'text-generation-east-1' reported 7 failed runs in the last 5m. paging on-call.

devon: getting this now, I see spike in probe failures but user-facing error rates are flat. tagging @sam for infra context.

sam: looking. probe graph: https://dash.redwood/synth/probes/text-generation-east-1 — failures cluster around 11:02-11:08 and are ~500ms timeouts.

maria: I can confirm no 5xx increase in public API logs. likely probe timeout threshold too tight after the recent model variant rollout.

ikhil: +1. We bumped model cold-start a bit yesterday; probe timeout still at 300ms. suggest bump to 700ms for now to reduce noise.

nora: are we sure it's not real customer impact? any support tickets?

devon: checked support queue — nothing correlating. latency SLOs for customers unchanged.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1891. Handoff channel: #eng-oncall.

sam: immediate mitigation plan: (1) silence probe alerts for text-generation-east-1 for 30m, (2) patch probe config, add debounce/cooldown, (3) create temporary dashboard to verify.

maria: I can apply the silence. devon, sam, can you approve the config patch?

devon: approving. going to mute via alert manager:
```
curl -XPOST "https://alertmgr.redwood/silence" -d '{"matcher":"probe=text-generation-east-1","duration":"30m","createdBy":"eng-oncall"}'
```

devon: done. silence id: s-7ff3.

ikhil: suggest changes to probe config: increase timeout -> 700ms, add consecutive_failures_before_alert -> 3 (was 1), add cooldown_window -> 5m. Also add jitter to frequency to avoid burst alignment.

nora: sounds reasonable. can we also adjust routing so that degraded probe doesn't reroute traffic to lower-capacity cluster? we should avoid auto-fallback on probe-only alerts.

sam: good call. current routing policy considers synth probe failure as a capacity signal. I'll open a quick rollback on that rule to only consider traffic metrics or SLA breaches.

maria: i'll push the probe config change now to staging then prod. config snippet:
```
probes:
  - name: text-generation-east-1
    freq_seconds: 60
    freq_jitter_seconds: 10
    timeout_ms: 700
    consecutive_failures: 3
    cooldown_minutes: 5
    alert_severity: warning
```

maria: applied to prod via infra pipeline, build 2026.3.7. Waiting for next runs.

devon: created ephemeral dashboard: https://dash.redwood/temp/synth-189123 — live view of success rate, median latency, and correlated model-variant deploys.

sam: checking the next probe run: success at 11:14 with 420ms. previous failures now gone.

ikhil: nice. do we want to reduce probe frequency to 90s to lower noise and cost? current probes run every 60s.

nora: i'd prefer keep 60s for 1h post-change, then evaluate. lower frequency might mask short regressions.

devon: agreed with nora. let's keep 60s for now, add the debounce and consecutive failures, and revisit after 2 hours.

ops-bot: NOTE: on-call handoff in 20m: devon -> sam. Please include this thread in handoff summary.

devon: handoff note for sam: synth probe flapping was noise due to tightened timeout after model variant rollout. mitigations done: 30m silence, probe timeout -> 700ms, consecutive_failures -> 3, cooldown -> 5m, jitter added. routing policy temporarily ignores probe-only signals. No customer-facing impact. monitor for 2h.

sam: got it. I'll take over once devon signs out. action items assigned:
- sam: create permanent dashboard tile and add alert suppression runbook (ETA: today EOD).
- maria: add these probe defaults to central probe-config repo and add test coverage (ETA: tomorrow morning).
- ikhil: audit routing policy rules that consider synth probes and propose safe gating (ETA: next sprint).
- devon: ensure silence s-7ff3 cleaned up after 30m and follow up if alerts resume.

maria: adding PR link: https://git.redwood/probes/merge_requests/452 — includes tests and rollout plan.

nora: can we also add a metric to the dashboard that shows 'probe-generated-pages' vs 'user-pages' to help oncall triage in future?

sam: yes. i'll add that tile.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: config rollout successful to prod at 11:12 UTC.

devon: signing out now, leaving monitoring to sam. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:

sam: thanks devon. taking over. I'll keep team updated if anything changes.

maria: small note for post-incident: update runbook to recommend checking model-variant cold-start cost before tightening timeouts.

ikhil: also add a line about synthetic probe jittering to avoid correlated failures across regions.

sam: will capture both in the postmortem. closing thread when follow-up PRs merged.

ops-bot: INC-2026-1891 status -> mitigated.
